description: Wallet risk check before you pay: is this wallet (and the site asking you to pay or sign) known to be sanctioned, a scammer or phishing? Screens the address against the US Treasury OFAC SDN wallet list (refreshed daily) and ScamSniffer's scam address list, the domain against ScamSniffer's 360k+ crypto phishing domains, and reads live on-chain basics (contract or wallet, transactions sent, balance) on Base, Ethereum, Polygon or Arbitrum. Returns high_risk / caution / no_known_risk with reasons. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free sample: call free_sample with tool="wallet_risk".

address.description: Wallet address to check (EVM 0x..., or a Solana address for the list checks)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, polygon or arbitrum: for the on-chain basics

domain.description: Optional: the site or URL asking you to pay or sign, checked against the phishing list

name: wallet_risk
title: Wallet Risk Check
